description.zh: 璀璨宝石的结构化规则定义。基于 board-game-ontology v0.1.0。
description.en: Structured rule definition for Splendor. Based on board-game-ontology v0.1.0.

definition.zh: 璀璨宝石中的宝石资源。共五种：<diamond>（钻石）、<sapphire>（蓝宝石）、<emerald>（绿宝石）、<ruby>（红宝石）、<onyx>（缟玛瑙）。<gem>是玩家购买<card>时的主要支付手段，也是游戏中最核心的<resource>。同色<gem>完全等价、可互相替代——玩家持有的是「3 颗蓝宝石」而非三个独立的个体。玩家可通过「拿取宝石」<action>从供应堆获取<gem>。注意：<gold>不属于<gem>，获取方式和使用规则均不同。
definition.en: Gem resources in Splendor. Five colors: diamond, sapphire, emerald, ruby, onyx. Gems are the primary payment method for purchasing <card>s and the most central <resource> in the game. Same-color gems are completely equivalent and interchangeable — a player holds '3 sapphires', not three distinct individuals. Players acquire gems through the 'take gems' <action> from the supply. Note: gold is not a gem; its acquisition method and usage rules differ.

description.zh: 宝石的计量单位。如「3 颗蓝宝石」「支付 2 颗钻石」。
description.en: Unit of measurement for gems. E.g., '3 sapphires', 'pay 2 diamonds'.

description.zh: 宝石颜色。white=钻石，blue=蓝宝石，green=绿宝石，red=红宝石，black=缟玛瑙
description.en: Gem color. white=diamond, blue=sapphire, green=emerald, red=ruby, black=onyx

description.zh: <gem>的外观描述。poker-chip 风格圆形厚片，中央印有一枚对应的图案，边缘一圈为对应的颜色。须包含 AI 向玩家解释「哪个是蓝宝石」时的关键视觉信息——颜色、质感、图案形状。
description.en: Visual description of <gem>. Poker-chip style round thick disc, with a corresponding symbol printed in the center and a ring of the corresponding color around the edge. Must include key visual information for AI to help players identify which color is which.

definition.zh: 白色/透明的<gem>。poker-chip 风格圆形厚片，中央印有一枚钻石图案，边缘一圈为白色。
definition.en: White/transparent <gem>. Poker-chip style round thick disc, with a diamond symbol printed in the center and a white ring around the edge.

description.zh: 固定为白色。
description.en: Fixed to white.

description.zh: 白色半透明圆形厚片，poker-chip 风格，表面有钻石切割纹理。
description.en: White translucent round disc, poker-chip style, with diamond cut texture on the surface.

definition.zh: 蓝色的<gem>。poker-chip 风格圆形厚片，中央印有一枚蓝宝石图案，边缘一圈为蓝色。
definition.en: Blue <gem>. Poker-chip style round thick disc, with a sapphire symbol printed in the center and a blue ring around the edge.

description.zh: 固定为蓝色。
description.en: Fixed to blue.

description.zh: 深蓝色不透明圆形厚片，poker-chip 风格。
description.en: Deep blue opaque round disc, poker-chip style.

definition.zh: 绿色的<gem>。poker-chip 风格圆形厚片，中央印有一枚绿宝石图案，边缘一圈为绿色。
definition.en: Green <gem>. Poker-chip style round thick disc, with an emerald symbol printed in the center and a green ring around the edge.

description.zh: 固定为绿色。
description.en: Fixed to green.

description.zh: 翠绿色不透明圆形厚片，poker-chip 风格。
description.en: Emerald green opaque round disc, poker-chip style.

definition.zh: 红色的<gem>。poker-chip 风格圆形厚片，中央印有一枚红宝石图案，边缘一圈为红色。
definition.en: Red <gem>. Poker-chip style round thick disc, with a ruby symbol printed in the center and a red ring around the edge.

description.zh: 固定为红色。
description.en: Fixed to red.

description.zh: 深红色不透明圆形厚片，poker-chip 风格。
description.en: Deep red opaque round disc, poker-chip style.

definition.zh: 黑色的<gem>。poker-chip 风格圆形厚片，中央印有一枚缟玛瑙图案，边缘一圈为黑色。
definition.en: Black <gem>. Poker-chip style round thick disc, with an onyx symbol printed in the center and a black ring around the edge.

description.zh: 固定为黑色。
description.en: Fixed to black.

description.zh: 黑色不透明圆形厚片，poker-chip 风格。
description.en: Black opaque round disc, poker-chip style.

definition.zh: 璀璨宝石中的发展卡——一种<card>。玩家通过支付<gem>费用购买<development_card>，将其从<market>移入自己的<development_area>，此后该卡永久提供<prestige_point>和<discount>。<development_card>分为三个等级（I/II/III），等级越高，费用越贵、<prestige_point>越多。
definition.en: Development cards in Splendor — a type of <card>. Players purchase <development_card>s by paying <gem> costs, moving them from the <market> to their <development_area>, after which the card permanently provides <prestige_point>s and a <discount>. <development_card>s come in three levels (I/II/III); higher levels have higher costs and more <prestige_point>s.

description.zh: <development_card>的外观描述。必须说明卡牌正面和背面的元素布局——正面：左上角为<prestige_point>数值（0~5，0 时不显示），右上角为<discount>的颜色图标，左下角为<cost>（若干<gem>的组合），中央为插画；背面：中央为等级标记（I/II/III），其余为统一的牌背图案。所有<development_card>背面依等级区分（同一等级背面相同），正面各不相同。AI 向玩家解释「怎么看一张发展卡」时以此字段为主要信息来源。
description.en: Visual description of <development_card>. Must describe the layout of the front and back faces — front: top-left shows prestige points (<prestige_point> value, 0-5, hidden when 0), top-right shows the discount gem icon (<discount> color), bottom-left shows the cost (combination of <gem>s), center is illustration; back: center shows the level marker (I/II/III), rest is a uniform card-back pattern. All <development_card> backs differ by level (identical within the same level), fronts are all unique. AI uses this field as the primary source when explaining 'how to read a development card'.

description.zh: 发展卡等级，位于卡牌背面中央。I=低级（费用低、<prestige_point>少），II=中级，III=高级（费用高、<prestige_point>多）。决定该卡归属哪个<deck>——游戏设置时按等级分为三叠独立的<deck>。
description.en: Development card level, located center of the card back. I=low (cheap, few <prestige_point>s), II=mid, III=high (expensive, many <prestige_point>s). Determines which <deck> the card belongs to — during setup, cards are separated into three independent <deck>s by level.

description.zh: 位于卡牌正面左上角。数值 0~5，0 时不显示数字。购买此卡后获得对应数量的<prestige_point>。
description.en: Located top-left of the card front. Value 0-5, not shown when 0. The player gains this many <prestige_point>s after purchasing the card.

description.zh: 购买此卡所需支付的费用，位于卡牌正面左下角。以若干<gem>的组合体现——如 3 颗<blue> + 2 颗<white> + 1 颗<green>。玩家支付此<cost>（可用<gold>替代任意颜色，可用<discount>抵扣）后方可获得此卡。
description.en: The cost to purchase this card, located bottom-left of the card front. Expressed as a combination of <gem>s — e.g., 3 <sapphire> + 2 <diamond> + 1 <emerald>. The player must pay this <cost> (using <gold> as wild and <discount>s to reduce) to acquire the card.

description.zh: 此卡提供的折扣效果，位于卡牌正面右上角。以一颗某种颜色的<gem>图标体现——表示该<player>此后购买任意<development_card>时，对应颜色费用减 1。
description.en: The discount this card provides, located top-right of the card front. Shown as a single <gem> icon of a specific color — this means the <player> subsequently pays 1 fewer <gem> of that color when buying any <development_card>.

description.zh: 每张<development_card>必有等级——决定其归属<deck>和强度区间。
description.en: Every <development_card> has a level — determines its <deck> and power bracket.

description.zh: 每张<development_card>必有购买费用——没有费用则无从交易。
description.en: Every <development_card> has a purchase cost — without one, there is no transaction.

description.zh: 每张<development_card>必提供一种颜色的折扣——这是该卡的核心永续效果。
description.en: Every <development_card> provides a discount of one color — this is the card's core continuous content.

description.zh: <prestige_point>可为零——零分时不显示数字，但仍需在实例中声明（显式 0 优于隐式缺失）。
description.en: <prestige_point> may be zero — when zero the number is hidden, but should still be declared in instances (explicit 0 is better than implicit absence).

definition.zh: 一级<development_card>。费用最低、<prestige_point>最少（通常 0~1 分），是游戏早期的核心获取目标。
definition.en: Level I <development_card>. Lowest cost, fewest <prestige_point>s (typically 0-1), the core acquisition target in the early game.

description.zh: 固定为 I 级。
description.en: Fixed to level I.

definition.zh: 二级<development_card>。费用和<prestige_point>居中（通常 1~3 分），是游戏中期的过渡目标。
definition.en: Level II <development_card>. Mid-range cost and <prestige_point>s (typically 1-3), the transitional target in the mid game.

description.zh: 固定为 II 级。
description.en: Fixed to level II.

definition.zh: 三级<development_card>。费用最高、<prestige_point>最多（通常 3~5 分），是游戏后期的高价值目标。
definition.en: Level III <development_card>. Highest cost, most <prestige_point>s (typically 3-5), the high-value target in the late game.

description.zh: 固定为 III 级。
description.en: Fixed to level III.

definition.zh: 璀璨宝石中的宝石供应堆——一种<supply>。存放游戏中所有可供<player>拿取的<gem>（五种颜色）。所有<player>均可从此<supply>直接取用——无需抽取、无需随机，<player>对「取多少、取哪些颜色」有完全控制力（受拿取规则限制）。<gem>被<player>花费后回归此<supply>。注意：<gold>存放在独立的<gold_supply>中，获取方式不同。
definition.en: Gem supply in Splendor — a <supply>. Holds all <gem>s (five colors) available for <player>s to take. All <player>s can take directly from this <supply> — no drawing, no randomness; the <player> has full control over 'how many and which colors' (subject to taking rules). <gem>s spent by <player>s are returned to this <supply>. Note: <gold> is stored in a separate <gold_supply> with different acquisition rules.

description.zh: 此<supply>存放的<object>类型：<gem>（五种颜色）。
description.en: The <object> types this <supply> holds: <gem> (five colors).

definition.zh: 璀璨宝石中的黄金供应堆——一种<supply>。仅存放<gold>。<gold>不能通过「拿取宝石」<action>获取——<player>只能通过「保留卡牌」<action>从此<supply>获得 1 颗<gold>（若还有剩余）。<gold>被<player>花费后回归此<supply>。
definition.en: Gold supply in Splendor — a <supply>. Holds only <gold>. <gold> cannot be acquired through the 'take gems' <action> — <player>s only gain 1 <gold> from this <supply> via the 'reserve card' <action> (if any remain). <gold> spent by <player>s is returned to this <supply>.

description.zh: 此<supply>存放的<object>类型：仅<gold>。
description.en: The <object> type this <supply> holds: <gold> only.

definition.zh: 璀璨宝石中存放<development_card>的<deck>。卡牌面朝下叠放，从顶部抽取以补充<card_market>。按等级分为三个独立<deck>——各等级<development_card>的数量和强度不同。
definition.en: A <deck> holding <development_card>s in Splendor. Cards are stacked face-down; drawn from the top to replenish the <card_market>. Separated into three independent <deck>s by level — each level has different card counts and power levels.

description.zh: 此<deck>存放的<object>类型：<development_card>。子类窄化为各自等级的<development_card>。
description.en: The <object> type this <deck> holds: <development_card>. Subclasses narrow to their respective level's <development_card>.

description.zh: 此<deck>的等级。决定存放哪种等级的<development_card>。
description.en: The level of this <deck>. Determines which level of <development_card> it holds.

definition.zh: 存放一级<development_card>的<development_deck>。
definition.en: A <development_deck> holding level I <development_card>s.

description.zh: 固定为 I 级。
description.en: Fixed to level I.

definition.zh: 存放二级<development_card>的<development_deck>。
definition.en: A <development_deck> holding level II <development_card>s.

description.zh: 固定为 II 级。
description.en: Fixed to level II.

definition.zh: 存放三级<development_card>的<development_deck>。
definition.en: A <development_deck> holding level III <development_card>s.

description.zh: 固定为 III 级。
description.en: Fixed to level III.

definition.zh: 璀璨宝石中的发展卡市场——一种<market>。从每个等级的<development_deck>顶部各翻开 4 张<development_card>，正面朝上陈列，供<player>购买或保留。共 12 张卡牌，按等级分三组：I 级 4 张、II 级 4 张、III 级 4 张。当某张<development_card>被<player>购买或保留后，立即从对应等级的<development_deck>顶部翻开一张新卡补充至空位。若对应<development_deck>已空，则该位置永久空置，场上可显示的总卡数减少。<card_market>与<noble_market>不同——<card_market>中的卡牌支持玩家主动购买（支付<cost>）和主动保留（拿取<gold>），是<player>每回合主要的操作目标。
definition.en: Development card market in Splendor — a <market>. From the top of each level's <development_deck>, 4 <development_card>s are revealed face-up and displayed for <player>s to buy or reserve. 12 cards total, organized in three groups by level: 4 Level I, 4 Level II, 4 Level III. When a <development_card> is bought or reserved by a <player>, a new card is immediately drawn from the top of the corresponding level's <development_deck> to fill the empty slot. If the corresponding <development_deck> is empty, that slot remains permanently vacant, reducing the total cards visible. Unlike <noble_market> — cards in the <card_market> can be actively bought (paying <cost>) or reserved (taking <gold>), making this the primary operational target each turn.

description.zh: 此<market>陈列的<object>类型：<development_card>（所有三个等级）。
description.en: The <object> type this <market> displays: <development_card> (all three levels).

description.zh: 发展卡市场的逻辑分组。按等级分三组、每组 4 张：{ "groups": 3, "per_group": 4, "by_level": true, "level_order": ["I", "II", "III"] }。每组对应一个等级的<development_deck>——从该<deck>顶部取卡补充。具体的物理摆放位置由<aid>（<public_board>）决定，与<card_market>自身的规则逻辑无关。
description.en: Logical grouping of the development card market. Three groups by level, 4 cards each: { "groups": 3, "per_group": 4, "by_level": true, "level_order": ["I", "II", "III"] }. Each group corresponds to a level's <development_deck> — cards are drawn from that <deck>'s top to replenish. Actual physical placement is determined by the <aid> (<public_board>), independent of the <card_market>'s rule logic.

description.zh: 补牌规则——按等级映射至对应的<deck>：{ "I": "<development_deck_level_1>", "II": "<development_deck_level_2>", "III": "<development_deck_level_3>" }。当某位置的<development_card>被取走后，立即从对应<development_deck>顶部翻开一张新卡补入。若对应<deck>已空，该位置不再补充。补牌发生在每次购买或保留操作完成后。
description.en: Replenishment rule — maps each level to its corresponding <deck>: { "I": "<development_deck_level_1>", "II": "<development_deck_level_2>", "III": "<development_deck_level_3>" }. When a <development_card> is taken from a slot, immediately draw a new card from the top of the corresponding <development_deck> to fill it. If the corresponding <deck> is empty, the slot is not refilled. Replenishment occurs after each purchase or reserve operation.

definition.zh: 璀璨宝石中的贵族市场——一种<market>。陈列所有可供获得的<noble>。与通常的<market>不同：<player>不能主动选择购买<noble>，而是在其回合结束时，若<development_area>满足某<noble>的获取条件，该<noble>自动归属该<player>。每枚<noble>只能被获得一次。
definition.en: Noble market in Splendor — a <market>. Displays all available <noble>s. Unlike a typical <market>: <player>s cannot actively choose to purchase a <noble>; instead, at the end of their turn, if their <development_area> meets a <noble>'s requirement, that <noble> is automatically granted to the <player>. Each <noble> can only be claimed once.

description.zh: 此<market>陈列的<object>类型：<noble>。
description.en: The <object> type this <market> displays: <noble>.

definition.zh: 璀璨宝石中的贵族板块——一种非购买型<tile>。<noble>不可用<gem>购买，而是当<player>的<development_area>中<development_card>的种类和数量满足<noble>的获取条件时，<player>可在其回合结束时自动免费获得<noble>。<noble>被获得后进入该<player>的<development_area>，提供 3 点<prestige_point>。每枚<noble>只能被获得一次。
definition.en: Noble tiles in Splendor — a non-purchasable <tile>. <noble>s cannot be bought with <gem>s; instead, when a <player>'s <development_area> contains the types and quantities of <development_card>s specified by the <noble>'s requirement, the <player> automatically and freely gains the <noble> at the end of their turn. The <noble> then enters the <player>'s <development_area> and provides 3 <prestige_point>s. Each <noble> can only be claimed once.

description.zh: <noble>的外观描述。必须说明板块正面的元素布局——左上角为<prestige_point>数值（固定 3），下方为获取条件（若干<development_card>的图案和数量，如「3 张蓝色 + 3 张绿色 + 3 张白色」），中央为贵族肖像插画。板块背面为统一图案。AI 向玩家解释「怎么看一枚贵族板块」时以此字段为主要信息来源。
description.en: Visual description of <noble>. Must describe the front face layout — top-left shows <prestige_point> value (fixed at 3), bottom shows the requirement (patterns and quantities of <development_card>s, e.g. '3 blue + 3 green + 3 white'), center is a noble portrait illustration. The back has a uniform pattern. AI uses this field as the primary source when explaining 'how to read a noble tile'.

description.zh: 位于板块正面左上角。固定为 3——每枚<noble>提供 3 点<prestige_point>。
description.en: Located top-left of the tile front. Fixed at 3 — each <noble> provides 3 <prestige_point>s.

description.zh: 获取条件，位于板块正面下方。以若干<development_card>的颜色和数量体现——如 { "blue": 3, "green": 3, "white": 3 } 表示需要<development_area>中至少有 3 张蓝色<development_card>、3 张绿色、3 张白色。当<player>的<development_area>满足此条件时，可在其回合结束时自动获得此<noble>。
description.en: Acquisition requirement, located at the bottom of the tile front. Expressed as colors and quantities of <development_card>s — e.g., { "blue": 3, "green": 3, "white": 3 } means the <development_area> must contain at least 3 blue, 3 green, and 3 white <development_card>s. When a <player>'s <development_area> meets this requirement, they automatically gain this <noble> at the end of their turn.

definition.zh: 璀璨宝石中的声望点数，即胜利分数（VP）。<prestige_point>是一种<resource>——不可被消费、不可被转移，只能通过购买<card>和吸引<noble>来获得。每张<card>和每个<noble>各提供固定数量的<prestige_point>。游戏终局时，拥有最多<prestige_point>的<player>获胜。
definition.en: Prestige points in Splendor, i.e. victory points (VP). <prestige_point> is a <resource> — it cannot be spent or transferred, only gained by purchasing <card>s and attracting <noble>s. Each <card> and <noble> provides a fixed number of <prestige_point>s. At endgame, the <player> with the most <prestige_point>s wins.

description.zh: 声望点数的计量单位。如「3 分」「15 分触发终局」。
description.en: Unit of measurement for prestige points. E.g., '3 points', '15 points triggers endgame'.

definition.zh: 璀璨宝石中的折扣效果——一种<continuous_content>。当一张<card>被打出并进入<development_area>后，该<card>提供对应颜色的永久<discount>：此后该<player>购买任意<card>时，所需<gem>费用中对应颜色减少 1 颗。<discount>可叠加——若<development_area>中有多张同色<card>，<discount>累加（如两张蓝色<card>提供 2 颗蓝宝石<discount>）。<discount>不经过<activation>——<card>进入<development_area>后自动开始生效。此<effect>的<cost>为 null（被动生效，无需支付代价），<content>为 null（不是一次性事件）。
definition.en: Discount effect in Splendor — a <continuous_content>. When a <card> is played into the <development_area>, it provides a permanent <discount> of its color: thereafter, when that <player> buys any <card>, the required <gem> cost of the corresponding color is reduced by 1. <discount>s stack — multiple cards of the same color in the <development_area> provide cumulative <discount>s (e.g. two blue <card>s give 2 sapphire <discount>). <discount> does not go through <activation> — it automatically takes effect when the <card> enters the <development_area>. This <effect>'s <cost> is null (passive, no cost to activate), <content> is null (not a one-time event).

description.zh: <discount>的受益者——即拥有来源<card>的<player>。<discount>仅对该<player>的后续购买生效。scope = self。
description.en: The beneficiary of the <discount> — the <player> who owns the source <card>. The <discount> only applies to this <player>'s future purchases. scope = self.

description.zh: <discount>的参数。{ "gem_color": "<gem>颜色枚举值", "amount": 1 }。amount 默认 1——每张<card>提供 1 颗对应颜色的<discount>。多张同色<card>的<discount>累加。
description.en: Discount parameters. { "gem_color": "<gem> color enum value", "amount": 1 }. amount defaults to 1 — each <card> provides 1 discount of its color. Multiple <card>s of the same color stack.

description.zh: 此折扣对应的<gem>颜色。购买<card>时，该颜色的费用需求减 1。
description.en: The <gem> color this <discount> applies to. When buying a <card>, the required cost of this color is reduced by 1.

definition.zh: 璀璨宝石中的黄金资源。<gold>是一种特殊的<resource>——它不属于<gem>，获取方式和使用规则均与<gem>不同。<gold>是百搭资源：支付<card>的<cost>时，1 颗<gold>可替代任意 1 颗<gem>。<gold>不能通过「拿取宝石」<action>获取——玩家只能通过「保留卡牌」<action>从供应堆获得 1 颗<gold>（若供应堆还有剩余）。
definition.en: Gold resource in Splendor. Gold is a special <resource> — it is not a <gem>, with distinct acquisition and usage rules. Gold is a wild resource: when paying a <card>'s <cost>, 1 gold can substitute for any 1 gem. Gold cannot be acquired through the 'take gems' <action> — players only gain gold through the 'reserve card' <action>, taking 1 gold from the supply (if available).

description.zh: 黄金的计量单位，与<gem>相同。如「1 颗黄金」「用黄金替代蓝宝石」。
description.en: Unit of measurement for gold, same as gems. E.g., '1 gold', 'substitute sapphire with gold'.

description.zh: <gold>的外观。poker-chip 风格圆形厚片，中央印有一枚黄金图案，边缘一圈为金色。与五种<gem>同尺寸但颜色明显不同。
description.en: Visual description of <gold>. Poker-chip style round thick disc, with a gold symbol printed in the center and a golden ring around the edge. Same size as the five <gem>s but distinctly different in color.

definition.zh: 璀璨宝石中的「拿取不同色宝石」<action>。玩家从<gem_supply>中选择颜色各不相同的<gem>各取 1 颗，数量由供应情况决定——≥3 种颜色时取 3 颗，仅有 1~2 种时取走全部可用颜色。规则响应为一次<transfer>。这是每回合可选的两种拿取宝石方式之一。
definition.en: The 'take different-colored gems' <action> in Splendor. The player takes 1 <gem> of each chosen color from <gem_supply>, quantity determined by availability — 3 when ≥3 colors are in stock, or all available colors when only 1-2 remain. The rules respond with a <transfer>. One of two gem-taking options per turn.

description.zh: 执行前提：<gem_supply>中至少存在 1 颗<gem>（任意颜色）。供应堆完全为空时此<action>不可选。注意：<player_holding>总数限制（10 颗）不在此处校验——拿取后若超出 10 颗，由回合结束时的 discard trigger 统一处理。
description.en: Precondition: <gem_supply> has at least 1 <gem> (any color). This <action> is unavailable only when the supply is completely empty. Note: the <player_holding> limit (10) is not checked here.

description.zh: 玩家选择的<gem>颜色数组。格式：{ "colors": ["blue", "green", "red"] }。数组长度不固定——≥3 种颜色可选时玩家任选 3 种，仅有 1~2 种时取走全部可用颜色。颜色必须互不相同，且对应颜色在<gem_supply>中必须有至少 1 颗存量。
description.en: Array of <gem> colors chosen by the player. Format: { "colors": ["blue", "green", "red"] }. Length is not fixed — player picks any 3 when ≥3 colors available, or takes all available when 1-2 remain. Colors must be distinct and each must have ≥1 in <gem_supply>.

description.zh: 因<player>选择拿取不同色宝石而触发的<event>序列。仅含一个<event>：一次<transfer>，将<declaration>中指定的<gem>从<gem_supply>移入该<player>的<player_holding>。
description.en: The <event> sequence triggered by the <player> choosing to take different-colored gems. Contains a single <event>: a <transfer> that moves the <gem>s specified in <declaration> from <gem_supply> to the <player>'s <player_holding>.

description.zh: 将<declaration>中指定的<gem>从<gem_supply>移入该<player>的<player_holding>。数量由<gem_supply>当前状态决定——≥3 色时为 3，仅 1~2 色时等于可用颜色数。<ownership_change>隐式发生。
description.en: Moves the <gem>s specified in <declaration> from <gem_supply> to the <player>'s <player_holding>. Quantity depends on <gem_supply> state — 3 when ≥3 colors, equals available color count when 1-2. <ownership_change> occurs implicitly.

description.zh: <transfer>的源<zone>。固定为<gem_supply>。
description.en: Source <zone> of the <transfer>. Fixed to <gem_supply>.

description.zh: <transfer>的目标<zone>。指向 actor 的<player_holding>。
description.en: Destination <zone> of the <transfer>. Points to the actor's <player_holding>.

description.zh: 被<transfer>的<object>。即<declaration>中玩家选择的<gem>，颜色各不同，数量 1~3 取决于<gem_supply>可用情况。
description.en: The <object>s being <transfer>red. The <gem>s chosen by the player in <declaration>, distinct colors, quantity 1-3 depending on <gem_supply> availability.

description.zh: <transfer>的数量。不固定——≥3 种颜色可选时为 3，1~2 种时等于<declaration>中 colors 数组的长度。
description.en: Quantity of the <transfer>. Not fixed — 3 when ≥3 colors available, equals the length of the colors array in <declaration> when 1-2.

rules.zh: 所选<gem>颜色必须两两不同。若<gem_supply>中可用颜色 ≥3 种，<player>任选 3 种各取 1 颗；若仅有 1~2 种颜色有存量，则必须取走所有可用颜色各 1 颗。
rules.en: The chosen <gem>s must be of distinct colors. If <gem_supply> has ≥3 colors available, the <player> picks any 3 and takes 1 of each. If only 1-2 colors are in stock, the <player> must take 1 of each available color.

definition.zh: 璀璨宝石中的「拿取同色宝石」<action>。玩家从<gem_supply>中选择一种颜色，取走该颜色的 2 颗<gem>。仅当所选颜色在<gem_supply>中有 ≥4 颗存量时才允许执行——拿取后该颜色至少剩余 2 颗，保证供应不会因单次拿取而枯竭。规则响应为一次<transfer>。这是每回合可选的两种拿取宝石方式之一。
definition.en: The 'take same-colored gems' <action> in Splendor. The player chooses one color and takes 2 <gem>s of that color from <gem_supply>. Only allowed when the chosen color has ≥4 in <gem_supply> — at least 2 remain after taking, so a single take cannot drain the stack. The rules respond with a <transfer>. One of two gem-taking options per turn.

description.zh: 执行前提：<gem_supply>中至少存在一种颜色的<gem>存量 ≥4。所有颜色存量均 <4 时此<action>不可选。注意：<player_holding>总数限制（10 颗）不在此处校验——拿取后若超出 10 颗，由回合结束时的 discard trigger 统一处理。
description.en: Precondition: at least one color in <gem_supply> has ≥4 <gem>s in stock. This <action> is unavailable when every color has fewer than 4. Note: the <player_holding> limit (10) is not checked here — if the total exceeds 10 after taking, the end-of-turn discard trigger handles it.

description.zh: 玩家选择的<gem>颜色。格式：{ "color": "blue" }。仅含一种颜色，且该颜色在<gem_supply>中必须有 ≥4 颗存量。
description.en: The <gem> color chosen by the player. Format: { "color": "blue" }. A single color that must have ≥4 in <gem_supply>.

description.zh: 因<player>选择拿取同色宝石而触发的<event>序列。仅含一个<event>：一次<transfer>，将<declaration>中指定颜色的 2 颗<gem>从<gem_supply>移入该<player>的<player_holding>。
description.en: The <event> sequence triggered by the <player> choosing to take same-colored gems. Contains a single <event>: a <transfer> that moves 2 <gem>s of the color specified in <declaration> from <gem_supply> to the <player>'s <player_holding>.

description.zh: 将<declaration>中指定颜色的 2 颗<gem>从<gem_supply>移入该<player>的<player_holding>。<ownership_change>隐式发生。
description.en: Moves 2 <gem>s of the color specified in <declaration> from <gem_supply> to the <player>'s <player_holding>. <ownership_change> occurs implicitly.

description.zh: <transfer>的源<zone>。固定为<gem_supply>。
description.en: Source <zone> of the <transfer>. Fixed to <gem_supply>.

description.zh: <transfer>的目标<zone>。指向 actor 的<player_holding>。
description.en: Destination <zone> of the <transfer>. Points to the actor's <player_holding>.

description.zh: 被<transfer>的<object>。即<declaration>中玩家选择颜色的 2 颗<gem>，两颗颜色相同。
description.en: The <object>s being <transfer>red. 2 <gem>s of the color chosen by the player in <declaration>, both of the same color.

description.zh: <transfer>的数量。固定为 2。
description.en: Quantity of the <transfer>. Fixed at 2.

rules.zh: 仅当<declaration>所选颜色在<gem_supply>中的存量 ≥4 时才允许拿取。拿取后该颜色剩余 ≥2 颗。
rules.en: Taking is only allowed when the color chosen in <declaration> has ≥4 in <gem_supply>. At least 2 of that color remain after taking.

definition.zh: 璀璨宝石中的「购买发展卡」<action>。玩家将一定种类和数量的<gem>从自己的<player_holding>返回供应堆——数量为发展卡的<cost>逐色减去<development_area>中已有<discount>（每色最低为 0），<gold>可替代任意颜色——并将该<development_card>从<card_market>（当面购买）或自己的<hand>（购买已保留的卡牌）打出至自己的<development_area>。返回的<gem>和<gold>分别回到<gem_supply>和<gold_supply>。若从<card_market>购买，立即从对应等级<development_deck>顶部翻一张新卡补入空位。购买后该卡永久提供<prestige_point>和<discount>。
definition.en: The 'purchase development card' <action> in Splendor. The player returns a set of <gem>s from their <player_holding> to the supply — the quantity per color being the development card's <cost> reduced by <discount>s already in <development_area> (minimum 0 per color), with <gold> substituting for any color — and plays that <development_card> from <card_market> (face-up purchase) or their own <hand> (buying a reserved card) into their <development_area>. Returned <gem>s and <gold> go back to <gem_supply> and <gold_supply> respectively. If bought from <card_market>, immediately reveal a new card from the top of the corresponding <development_deck> to fill the slot. The purchased card permanently provides <prestige_point>s and a <discount>.

description.zh: 执行前提：目标<development_card>位于<card_market>或 actor 的<hand>中，且 actor 的<player_holding>足以返回所需<gem>——各色持有量（<gold>可补任意颜色的缺口）不少于该卡<cost>逐色减去<discount>后的数量。与拿取宝石不同，此<action>不受<player_holding>上限约束——返回只会减少持有量。
description.en: Precondition: the target <development_card> is in <card_market> or in the actor's <hand>, and the actor's <player_holding> holds enough <gem>s to return — each color's holdings (<gold> filling any color's gap) are no less than the card's <cost> reduced by <discount>s per color. Unlike taking gems, this <action> is not constrained by the <player_holding> limit — returning only reduces holdings.

description.zh: 玩家的购买声明。格式：{ "card": "<development_card 的 id>", "payment": { "diamond": 1, "sapphire": 2, "gold": 1 } }。card 必须位于<card_market>或 actor 的<hand>中；payment 声明返回供应堆的各色<gem>和<gold>数量——各色<gem>+<gold>须恰好等于该色<cost>减去<discount>后的数量，<gold>可分配至任意颜色。
description.en: The player's purchase declaration. Format: { "card": "<development_card id>", "payment": { "diamond": 1, "sapphire": 2, "gold": 1 } }. The card must be in <card_market> or the actor's <hand>; payment declares the <gem>s and <gold> of each color to return to the supply — <gem>s + <gold> per color must exactly equal that color's <cost> reduced by <discount>s, with <gold> allocatable to any color.

description.zh: 因<player>购买<development_card>而触发的<event>序列，按序包含两个<event>：(1) 一次<transfer>——将一定种类和数量的<gem>从 actor 的<player_holding>返回供应堆，数量为发展卡的<cost>减去<discount>；(2) 一次<play>——将目标<development_card>从<card_market>或 actor 的<hand>打出至 actor 的<development_area>。
description.en: The <event> sequence triggered by the <player> purchasing a <development_card>, containing two <event>s in order: (1) a <transfer> — returning a set of <gem>s from the actor's <player_holding> to the supply, the quantity being the development card's <cost> reduced by <discount>s; (2) a <play> — playing the target <development_card> from <card_market> or the actor's <hand> into the actor's <development_area>.

description.zh: 将一定种类和数量的<gem>从 actor 的<player_holding>返回供应堆——数量为发展卡的<cost>逐色减去 actor <development_area>中已有<discount>（每色最低为 0），<gold>可替代任意颜色。<gem>回到<gem_supply>，<gold>回到<gold_supply>。
description.en: Returns a set of <gem>s from the actor's <player_holding> to the supply — the quantity per color being the development card's <cost> reduced by <discount>s already in the actor's <development_area> (minimum 0 per color), with <gold> substituting for any color. <gem>s return to <gem_supply>, <gold> to <gold_supply>.

description.zh: <transfer>的源<zone>。指向 actor 的<player_holding>。
description.en: Source <zone> of the <transfer>. Points to the actor's <player_holding>.

description.zh: <transfer>的目标<zone>。<gem>回到<gem_supply>，<gold>回到<gold_supply>——按<object>类型分别归入。
description.en: Destination <zone> of the <transfer>. <gem>s return to <gem_supply>, <gold> to <gold_supply> — each <object> type goes to its own supply.

description.zh: 被<transfer>的<object>。即<declaration>的 payment 中声明的各色<gem>和<gold>。
description.en: The <object>s being <transfer>red. The <gem>s of each color and <gold> declared in the <declaration>'s payment.

rules.zh: 各色返回数量 = max(0, <cost>[色] − actor<development_area>中该色<discount>总数)。payment 中各色<gem>数量不得超过该色返回数量，<gold>补足差额；各色<gem>+<gold>之和必须恰好等于返回数量。
rules.en: The quantity returned per color = max(0, <cost>[color] − total <discount>s of that color in the actor's <development_area>). <gem>s of each color in payment may not exceed that color's return quantity, and <gold> makes up the difference; <gem>s + <gold> per color must exactly equal the return quantity.

description.zh: 将目标<development_card>打出至 actor 的<development_area>。目标卡可来自<card_market>（当面购买）或 actor 的<hand>（购买已保留的卡牌）。打出后<ownership_change>隐式发生，该卡的<discount>与<prestige_point>自此生效。
description.en: Plays the target <development_card> into the actor's <development_area>. The target may come from <card_market> (face-up purchase) or the actor's <hand> (buying a reserved card). After the play, <ownership_change> occurs implicitly and the card's <discount> and <prestige_point>s take effect from now on.

description.zh: <play>的源<zone>。<card_market>或 actor 的<hand>——由<declaration>中 card 当前所在位置决定。
description.en: Source <zone> of the <play>. <card_market> or the actor's <hand> — determined by where the card in <declaration> currently resides.

description.zh: <play>的目标<zone>。指向 actor 的<development_area>。
description.en: Destination <zone> of the <play>. Points to the actor's <development_area>.

description.zh: 被打出的<object>。即<declaration>中指定的目标<development_card>，固定 1 张。
description.en: The <object> being played. The target <development_card> specified in <declaration>, exactly 1 card.

rules.zh: 该卡的<discount>即刻生效，但不作用于本次购买。若目标卡来自<card_market>，立即从对应等级<development_deck>顶部翻一张新卡补入空位（该<deck>已空则空位不再补充）；若来自<hand>，不触发补牌。
rules.en: The card's <discount> takes effect immediately but does not apply to this purchase. If the target came from <card_market>, immediately reveal a new card from the top of the corresponding <development_deck> to fill the slot (if that <deck> is empty, the slot stays vacant); if it came from <hand>, no replenishment occurs.

description.zh: 此<player_holding>存放的<object>类型：<gem>（五种颜色）和<gold>。玩家通过「拿取宝石」或「保留卡牌」<action>获得的宝石和黄金存放于此，购买<development_card>时从此处支付。
description.en: The <object> types this <player_holding> holds: <gem> (five colors) and <gold>. Gems and gold acquired via the 'take gems' or 'reserve card' <action> are held here and spent from here when purchasing a <development_card>.

description.zh: 宝石持有上限，固定为 10。<player>持有的<gem>和<gold>总数达到 10 时，回合开始时不可再执行「拿取宝石」<action>，必须先通过购买<development_card>消耗至 10 以下。
description.en: Gem holding limit, fixed at 10. When a <player>'s total <gem> and <gold> count reaches 10, they cannot perform the 'take gems' <action> at the start of their turn and must first spend down below 10 by purchasing a <development_card>.

description.zh: 从<player_zone>继承，<player_holding>始终归属于一个<player>。
description.en: Inherited from <player_zone>, <player_holding> always belongs to a <player>.

description.zh: 此<development_area>存放的<object>类型：<development_card>和<noble>。玩家购买<development_card>或获得<noble>后，将其移入此区域。此区域中的<development_card>永久提供<prestige_point>和<discount>，<noble>提供<prestige_point>。
description.en: The <object> types this <development_area> holds: <development_card> and <noble>. After purchasing a <development_card> or gaining a <noble>, the <player> moves it here. <development_card>s here permanently provide <prestige_point>s and <discount>; <noble>s provide <prestige_point>s.

description.zh: 从<player_zone>继承，<development_area>始终归属于一个<player>。
description.en: Inherited from <player_zone>, <development_area> always belongs to a <player>.

description.zh: 此<hand>存放的<object>类型：<development_card>（所有三个等级）。保留卡牌时从<card_market>直接移入。
description.en: The <object> type this <hand> holds: <development_card> (all three levels). Moved directly from <card_market> when reserving.

description.zh: 手牌上限，固定为 3。达到上限后不可再执行「保留卡牌」<action>。
description.en: Hand capacity, fixed at 3. The 'reserve card' <action> is unavailable when full.

description.zh: 从<player_zone>继承，<hand>始终归属于一个<player>。
description.en: Inherited from <player_zone>, <hand> always belongs to a <player>.

appearance.zh: 由两个零件拼成的钻石形状。
appearance.en: Two pieces that fit together to form a diamond shape.
